caseNameFull: Fletcher v. Wool Fletcher v. Willard R. Cook & Co., Inc. Fletcher v. D. H. Goodman, Inc. Fletcher v. Krise, Receiver Fletcher v. Barron Fletcher v. National Bank of Commerce Fletcher v. National Bank of Commerce and Fletcher v. Maupin

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson and Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of these applications.

Reported below: 138 F. 2d 740, 742.
